Q1.evidence: Every file imports jakarta.persistence / jakarta.validation (e.g. orders/Order.java, coupon/dto/CreateCouponRequest.java); there are no javax.* imports

Q2.evidence: OrderApplication is in com.example.order, and every component is under com.example.order.* (common, coupon, idempotency, orders, payment, product)

Q3.evidence: build.gradle: web/validation/data-jpa starters plus flyway-core, flyway-database-postgresql and the postgresql driver; no starter covers these, so none are redundant

Q4.evidence: orders/OrderService.create(CreateOrderRequest) builds and returns an HTTP response (StoredResponse(201, json, "/api/orders/"+id)); coupon/CouponService.create(CreateCouponRequest) and product/ProductService take request DTOs and return CouponResponse/ProductResponse; orders/PaymentService.pay builds a StoredResponse(200, ...)

Q5.evidence: All components use constructor injection with final fields (e.g. OrderService, OrderFacade, IdempotencyStore, OrderQueryRepositoryImpl); no @Autowired field injection

Q6.evidence: Request/response bodies are records (CreateOrderRequest, OrderResponse, CouponResponse, ProductResponse, etc.); entities are converted with from(); OrderController returns the record serialized to JSON

Q8.evidence: The controllers only delegate to services/facade; OrderController.list only converts request parameters; no @Transactional and no direct repository access

Q9.evidence: @Transactional appears only in the service classes (OrderService, PaymentService, CouponService, ProductService); the get/list methods use readOnly = true

Q10.evidence: No service uses HttpStatus/ResponseEntity/ResponseStatusException; they throw the domain exception BusinessException(ErrorCode). Borderline: OrderService/PaymentService still write status numbers 201/200 into StoredResponse (counted under Q4)

Q11.evidence: common/error/GlobalExceptionHandler (@RestControllerAdvice) handles BusinessException, DataIntegrityViolationException, Exception and the framework exceptions in one place

Q12.evidence: GlobalExceptionHandler.build/handleExceptionInternal build a ProblemDetail and set the content type to APPLICATION_PROBLEM_JSON

Q13.evidence: GlobalExceptionHandler.handleMethodArgumentNotValid adds field/message pairs to the errors property (request-body validation only). Borderline: header/query-parameter validation failures and handleConstraintViolation return 400 without per-field details

Q14.evidence: GlobalExceptionHandler.handleAny/handleDataIntegrity return the fixed text "Internal server error"; handleExceptionInternal also uses fixed text for status >= 500

Q16.evidence: OrderService.list (readOnly transaction) reads items in OrderResponse.from; application.yml has hibernate.default_batch_fetch_size: 100 for batch loading, and items are accessed inside the transaction

Q17.evidence: application.yml: password is injected via an environment variable, PG URL comes from ${PAYMENT_GATEWAY_URL}; PaymentGatewayConfig injects it through PaymentGatewayProperties

Q20.evidence: payment/PaymentGatewayProperties(url, timeout) and orders/OrderProperties(paymentTtl, expirySweepIntervalMs) are bound with @ConfigurationProperties records (@ConfigurationPropertiesScan)
